name: Dreams of Sword Art
description: A nameless samurai stands atop the windy sea cliffs, seemingly searching for something...

steps.description: Search for the blade mentioned by the nameless samurai
Search for the blade mentioned by the nameless samurai
Give the blade to the nameless samurai
Help the nameless samurai find the wine
Ask the soldiers about the wine
Give the wine to the nameless samurai
Search for the blade mentioned by "Masanori"
Search for the blade mentioned by "Masanori"

dialogs.content: Come, draw your weapon and try your chances against me.
I am defeated.
I have cut countless people down, and have never once lost. Now that I have tasted defeat at your hands... I have bet and lost. I shall have no regrets even if it has cost me my life.
I don't do that kind of thing.
Haha! I draw my sword to kill. You do not?
You fight strangely, and your bearing is far from normal. Not at all like those who I cut down.
Which school do you belong to?
Heh, unwilling to say, are you? It matters little. I remember nothing at all, so even had you mentioned your school of swordsmanship, I would not recognize it.
Who was I? What did I do before drifting here? I... no longer remember any of these things.
I only feel familiarity and peace with my sword in hand. Someone as lost as I must be doomed to wander this wasteland.
I can try to help you.
But not knowing even my own name, I cannot do anything but wander the world like a ghost. How can you help me?
I do not know if I have family, or where my hometown is. There is nowhere for me to go but here.
The only connection I have to that past is my swordsmanship.
And where did you learn yours?
My lineage... I no longer recall it, but it could not have come from nowhere.
On this path, there is little hope for those who have no background at all.

Even if one begins training hard from an early age, they cannot receive accurate instruction if they cannot pay a master to tutor them. They will have to go through many more twists and turns than the average person.
Without a good sword, they can only go to the smelting plant to look for a discarded, inferior blade.
Though it be inferior, they would cherish it, and even give the blade a name.
They would train with every ounce of sweat in their body, and after many wounds and much persistence, they would gain a foundation... and yet they would still be mocked.
Without a friend by their side, they would not be able to go on...
Wait... Why... Why does this all feel so familiar?
I think... I think I remember something. Two children wielding swords and sparring, next to their family homes... a hut...

Yes... they lived in <color=#00E1FFFF>a hut in the fishing village to the north</color>... the hut was <color=#00E1FFFF>under a cliff</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>surrounded by sea on all sides</color>.
They would take the <color=#00E1FFFF>steps behind the house</color> to the <color=#00E1FFFF>slope</color> to spar... Their blades might still be there.
But who were "they"? Ugh, my head hurts. I can't... remember...
Didn't you say that you would help me? Then please, help me find those two sword-wielding children, and bring me their swords. I... I think their swords may be related to me somehow.
I understand.
A samurai's word is his bond. I will wait here for you until you have brought me those swords.
Who did you learn the sword from?
I'm just a traveler.
You should really just stop.
Who were those two children? Ugh, my head hurts. I can't... remember...
Where did they live again?

Yes... they lived in <color=#00E1FFFF>a hut in the fishing village to the north</color>... the hut was <color=#00E1FFFF>under a cliff</color>, and <color=#00E1FFFF>surrounded by sea on all sides</color>.
They would take the <color=#00E1FFFF>steps behind the house</color> to the <color=#00E1FFFF>slope</color> to spar... Their blades might still be there.
A samurai's word is his bond. I will wait here for you until you have brought me those swords.
Have you found the swords?
I remember. This... one of the two children used this sword.
That child, he and his friend sneaked off to the smelting plant to obtain two identical swords that the smiths had discarded.
The finest of blades were made there, but these two were of an inferior make, so those two children...
I remember now, they would be mocked by others for not being able to afford swords made by famous smiths, and for using junk.
Hah. I say, as long as it can slay foes in battle, it is a good blade.
Who in this world is born bearing gold and jade? Nor does the battlefield distinguish between the noble and the lowly.
Samurai, have you ever been on the battlefield?
I am no samurai.
You have not sought out a master despite your abilities? Folly.
You should. One strike, and one strike only, is all it takes for someone to fall, whether they be a mighty general or a lowly ashigaru! Hahaha.
But... I cannot die. No matter how many swordsmen or ronin came to challenge me, I was never defeated.
Those who are only swordsmen in name... They fled, or they were all cut down. Hahah!
You are the only one who has managed to defeat me... Curses. Curses! How did I lose?
Curses! Curses! CURSES!
Again! We will go again! I will not lose this time!
No, I have not.
Are you ready?
Give me a moment.
I will let you prepare. Takatsuki Dougire and I will be here, no matter how long we must wait.
Use your full strength against me once you are ready.
Well, if you're ready to lose...
Many have said this before Takatsuki Dougire cut them down. How many blows will you withstand?
You have defeated me... again.
Will you not tell me where you learned your swordsmanship from?
Do all true masters hide their true selves like this? Never mind. I shall not pry.
It has been so long since I felt this fulfilled. Discarding all pointless thought and giving myself over to the blade.
How strange... My body remembers this refreshing feeling as well.
It's almost like... I could gain acceptance, own everything in this world... when I was wielding my sword, when my all was focused on winning victory.
Yes, that's right. I once wielded this sword to sunder many armored bodies.

I remember how I felt then. Mora and honor could all be gained by the sword. As long as I had the last laugh at the end of the raging battle, what did anything else matter? To the victor go the spoils!
The spoils, the glory... So, I had such moments of satisfaction in my time, did I? When I was crowned with honor, acknowledged by my superiors, when the wine flowed freely...
Wine... wine... How could I forget the wine I drank under the moonlight with my companions? I miss that taste.
You've remembered!
I remember now! I remember drinking wine together with people... it was a long time ago.
I remember that we were inside a <color=#00E1FFFF>great encampment</color>. Men <color=#00E1FFFF>armed and dressed in armor</color> were all around us.
We said something then... No, I can't remember it.
Perhaps you'll remember if you drank the same wine from back then.
You'll... you'll help me find that wine?
I can.
I... I am in your debt. Perhaps I shall indeed remember my past if I drank the same wine that I did back then.
Where did you drink?
I've told you, I'm a traveler.
Armored and armed men... does he mean soldiers from an army camp?
If we head east from here, we'll reach some land that's mostly flat. Maybe that's where the camp is.
Who did I drink with... what did we say...
I hope this fragile peace will hold out a little longer...
Do you know of a nameless samurai?
I've never heard of some strange guy like that. You're barking up the wrong tree here.
Hmm? Why is a civilian like you wandering around in the military camp?
Do you know of a nameless samurai?
Serving no master, and slaying no foe on the battlefield. The person you speak of must be a ronin.
There is no place in my army for such a person.
Besides, order is valued above all here in a military encampment. This is no place for civilians to walk in and out of as they please. Please leave quickly.
The Sangonomiya rebels are just riff-raff.
Do you know of a nameless samurai?
Hmm. Born into a fishing village, joined the army, and that manner of speech... I think I know who you're talking about.
After that last battle ended, a lot of folks went missing in action, that guy included.
Usually, people who end up unaccounted for have either deserted or... you know, bought the farm.
But that guy? With his skills, I don't think any of those riff-raff from Sangonomiya could have beaten him. I thought he'd fled.
I never would've imagined that he'd lost his memories and become a madman who only knows how to wield a sword.
Well then, were you here to ask about him, or did you want to do something else?
Please help him regain his memory.
Eh? You know, I wouldn't necessarily call losing your memories of the battlefield a bad thing, exactly.
But you look like a good person. I mean, you came all this way just to help him out.
As an old friend of his, I would like to help, but...
As you can see, I have my duties here, and I cannot leave.
I just need the wine that he drank in the past.
Wine... That's all you need, then?
I've got it. I'll give you my personal bottle of it, in fact.
Back when he was still in the army, he, a friend from his hometown, and I would drink together.
They were both of lowly birth, and would often be ostracized by those fools from richer families.
He was a rough man who didn't care a whit about being excluded. He just threw himself into battle all the same...
The General at the time quite liked him, and raised both him and his hometown friend to the rank of Hatamoto.
But during that battle...
*sigh* I always come to back to something awful whenever I think about the past. There's no point in nattering on, so I shan't.
Well, you have the wine. If there's nothing else, best you take your leave.
This is a military encampment, after all. If you tarry here too long, people might get the wrong idea.
I'd like to know about his past.
His past? As far as I'm aware, it's nothing particular happy...
Did you find the wine?
This wine... it's bitter. That's not right.
I remember that the wine we drank before wasn't like this. It only had the taste of excitement and joy.
We took names and won glory... Should we not have been pleased with ourselves? And yet, why does this wine go down my throat so bitterly?
And this bottle, I remember it. It has to be...
He would take this bottle, and he would say: "Come on, Masanori, have another!"
"Masanori"... "Masanori"... is that my name?
So that's your name. Masanori.
Yes, yes, I remember! I would often drink with the same person. He and I were like brothers, and we would talk often.
But there was just this once, when he said something that... led to an argument, and so he left.
He was my brother-in-arms, through thick and thin. Why would he just leave like that... Why?
What did I do wrong? Do you know, samurai?
You probably need to ask yourself that question.
But I want to know. I must know. Please, I want to know... I want to...
Maybe it's for the best that you don't know.
It's a fine name.
My head... It hurts... Please, I beg of you, fight me once more. Use your blade to help me remember. Help me remember everything!
Let me think about it.
What? What are you waiting for?
Well then, have at it.
Let us cross swords.
Defeated by the same person thrice. How am I this weak? I have honed my martial arts ability from childhood to today... How am I so useless?
Useless... useless... I'm a useless samurai... Wait, I remember now.
I saw a sword fall from someone's hands, and it wasn't Takatsuki Dougire. The sight of that sword sent me trembling all over, and my courage failed me...
I feared that fallen sword, and I fled from there, and ended up here.
And where's that place?
I... I fled here from the <color=#00E1FFFF>tidal flats in the northwest</color>. That was where the battle took place.
Why was I so afraid of that sword? What happened there?
I'll help you remember.
Remember, I have to remember, that sword... that sword...
I'll help you find that sword.
Remember, I have to remember, that sword... that sword...
This is that sword. Yes, that was his sword.
But where is he? Where did he go? We agreed to go home together!
What's come over you?
Why wasn't he there!? Argh... How can this be!!!
I... I have truly been defeated.
I put everything on the line to wield my sword, but the martial arts that I so worshiped... they have been truly and pathetically beaten.
Have you awakened?
You need not worry. I lost control earlier... Never again will I raise my hand against you of my own will.
I fought you to my heart's content four times, and discovered some shattered memories, obtained two swords, and a bottle of wine. I am satisfied.
Moreover, the more I remember, the more I feel anger and a deep pain rise up from within me. Perhaps my past is indeed far from a beautiful story.
I doubt I will gain much from becoming obsessed with it, so it is best that I put it down.
Nonetheless, I believe it to be greatly fortuitous that we met. I do not regret it.
The feeling is mutual.
Hah, you are indeed straightforward.
I shall also be frank. I may be to you as a defeated foe, but if you are willing, I still wish to exchange pointers with you.
Warriors make friends best when their swords clash, rather than when they talk around a table.
I and Takatsuki Dougire will remain here, watching the sea and listening to the wind. We will be here any time to speak to you, should you wish it.
Hahah, I'm still a little afraid of you.
So we're not going to spar again?
Let us duel once more, you and I.
Give me a second.
I will let you prepare. Takatsuki Dougire and I will be here, no matter how long we must wait.
Use your full strength against me once you are ready.
Well, if you're ready to lose...
Many have said this before Takatsuki Dougire cut them down. How many blows will you withstand?

Let me think about it.

Well then, have at it.
Let us cross swords.

Huh. This person you speak of seems rather strange. I've never encountered such a person.
That said, there's been an arrest warrant out for some reckless fool who actually dared to take the Shogun on. That certainly sounds a little like the person you're talking about.
What does the wanted fugitive look like, you ask? Uh... How did I forget that? Really, now...
But I'd stay away from that guy if I were you. What if they're the wanted fugitive? I'd focus on keeping my head on my shoulders if I were you.
Hmm? Why is a civilian like you wandering around in the military camp?
Do you know of a nameless samurai?
Serving no master, and slaying no foe on the battlefield. The person you speak of must be a ronin.
There is no place in my army for such a person.
Are you just here to look for someone? If you are, please leave as soon as possible.
I've received word that some scoundrel infiltrated the city and attempted to ambush our Almighty Shogun. My forces have also received an arrest warrant for this criminal.
Well, you've also got blond hair. Best you leave, or you might be mistaken for that wanted fugitive.

Looking at your thin build, forget surviving a battle with the Shogun — I personally doubt you'd be able to parry my spear even once. I have no wish to involve commoners in these struggles unnecessarily.
Still, you do look quite familiar...
Huh? I—I'm sure we've never met, good sir!
...Mm, fair enough.
I'll head home immediately.

Strangers like yourself would be wise not to stay here long, or some people might get the wrong idea.

His past? As far as I'm aware, it's nothing particular happy...
Remember, I have to remember, that sword... that sword...
*sigh* This guy isn't gonna listen to a word you say. Come on, let's go and try to find that sword before he goes berserk again.
